description:
Project Overview
Rotary Club of Mumbai Pioneers, in association with Rotaract Club of Mumbai Downtown, proudly supported the Ganpati Celebrations 2026 by sponsoring medals worth ₹20,000 for the winners of various sports, cultural, creative and recreational events.
The initiative aimed to encourage participation, recognise talent, promote sportsmanship and strengthen community bonding during the auspicious festival of Ganesh Chaturthi. Through this support, both clubs contributed towards making the celebrations more engaging, inclusive and memorable for participants of all ages.
